summary: The root م-ع-ي primarily signifies being with someone or something, indicating companionship, presence, or association. It can also denote support or agreement, implying a shared state or action.

headwords.def: الأَمْعَاءُ i. q. الأَقْصَابُ ; (AO: see voce قِتْبٌ ;) the guts; i. e. bowels, or intestines, into which the food passes from the stomach: الحَشَا is the name of all the places of the food; and in the belly are the أَعْفَاج and the أَقْتَاب , to which the food passes after the stomach, and these are the lower امعاء ; and all these are called the قُصْب : the حَوَايَا are all the امعاء that wind, or take a coiled, or circular, form. (Zj, in his “ Khalk el-Insán. ”) أَمْعَآءُ : see a tropical signification ( water-holes ) of this pl. voce حَوِيَّةُ .
